video_title: Knicks HISTORIC Comeback Set Up 3-1 Lead, Spurs' Bright Future & Fan Violence | Anunoby Finals MVP?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Knicks' historic comeback against the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: This was just a meltdown. This was like watching ice cream melt in the sun.
quotes.quote: This was just a meltdown. This was like watching ice cream melt in the sun. It was like, oh, it's going, it's going, it's gone. I'm still in disbelief. I'm shocked. I know a lot of the blame is going on De'Aaron Fox and everything, but it's a lot of players that's in concussion protocol right now for the Spurs.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre on the Knicks' historic championship drought
quotes.excerpt: I think the Knicks somehow, man, some way, get their first championship since 1973.
quotes.quote: I think the Knicks somehow, man, some way, get their first championship since 1973. Since the first president. Since George Washington was president.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the Spurs' collapse against the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: It was hard to believe. I thought somebody was messing with the score.
quotes.quote: It was hard to believe. I thought somebody was messing with the score when I was looking at it. I'm like, this score can't be right. But I rewatched the game again today and I'm like, wondering what the fuck happened. And like, as Pierce said, it was a slow, gradual, grinded out game by New York. They were up 29 at one point, and they cut it in half by the fourth. So, it was like a 13-0 run, then it was like a 13-6, a 16-8 run, and it ended up being 15 by going to the fourth. So, San Antonio just stopped scoring.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the Knicks' offensive strategy in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: They kept bringing Wembanyama in the pick and roll. They're trying to get a switch.
quotes.quote: They kept bringing Wembanyama in the pick and roll. They're trying to get a switch to get Castle off of Jalen Brunson, right? Whether it was Champagnie, whether it was Vassell, but mostly Wembanyama. They were trying to get Wembanyama in the pick and roll so that he could corral, and when he's in the corral, when Brunson got off the ball fast, it left OG wide open for threes, or somebody else getting like Jose Alvarado. Jose hit a big three and OG was just hitting everything, or somebody could drive at the rim. And that's how they kind of got back into it.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Spurs' offensive rhythm
quotes.excerpt: It's almost like there's a magnet in the rim every time the Spurs shoot the ball.
quotes.quote: It's almost like there's a magnet in the rim every time the Spurs shoot the ball. It's like they can't miss.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the impact of Zach Collins' foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: It all started really for the Knicks when Cat got into foul trouble.
quotes.quote: It all started really for the Knicks when Cat got into foul trouble. If Cat doesn't get into foul trouble, they have to play Huk Porti. I haven't seen Jeremy Sochan play in like two months. I don't know if he played in the games that they blew people out in. You know what I'm saying? Like, they put in Huk Porti, I'm like, this is bad. And then their offense gets junked up and ugly. And that was the turning point.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Spurs' defensive struggles
quotes.excerpt: I'm giving him the Finals MVP. Take that home, OG.
quotes.quote: I'm giving him the Finals MVP. Take that home, OG. I'm telling you, take home the Finals MVP.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre on De'Aaron Fox's performance
quotes.excerpt: I do want to get into the De'Aaron Fox thing, because I know people are killing him.
quotes.quote: I do want to get into the De'Aaron Fox thing, because I know people are killing him for not dribbling it out. But OG was right next to him and was about to foul him. So, like to me, a layup or free throws, which one is better? Especially after your best player just bricked two clutch free throws. I'm probably like, I got I'm De'Aaron Fox, I'm faster than everybody. I got the layup.

quotes.speaker: John Calipari
quotes.summary_phrase: John Calipari on De'Aaron Fox's mindset after the loss
quotes.excerpt: I want you to have the vision and the mindset that we won that game.
quotes.quote: I want you to have the vision and the mindset that we won that game. Don't even think about that we lost. Let's all say, what would we be our mindset if we won that game? Well, guess what, we just won the game. Now let's go play the next game. That's, and then I was fired by the Knicks. Just so, I'm just being honest. I don't know who wants to listen to me, but go ahead.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Victor Wembanyama's performance
quotes.excerpt: He's the most important player this series for the Knicks.
quotes.quote: He's the most important player this series for the Knicks. And I knew he was going to kill because they have nobody to match up with him when they focus on those other guys.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre on Victor Wembanyama's inbound play
quotes.excerpt: KAT told Knicks fans to get closer to Dylan Harper on the final inbounds play.
quotes.quote: KAT told Knicks fans to get closer to Dylan Harper on the final inbounds play. Because fans have a right to stand wherever the fuck they want on the sideline. This is fucking incredible. Um, it's not against the rules, you know what I mean? And he tipped that pass.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the referee's missed call
quotes.excerpt: This is on Dylan and the referee. Like Dylan's got to be like, yo, tell these motherfuckers to back up.
quotes.quote: This is on Dylan and the referee. Like Dylan's got to be like, yo, tell these motherfuckers to back up. Get them space. Cat's got to give me three feet. Like they got to give me space so I can see. Referee supposed to handle that. Cat on Cat's part, this is smart. Cat did what he's supposed to do. He did his job. Yo, get in close. Make the crowd make them feel smothered, make them get claustrophobic real quick, and make them rush. So he did his job. But, you know, Dylan, as a this is a rookie thing, he's got to he'll learn this as it goes on.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Jalen Brunson's over/under
quotes.excerpt: This is going to be tough, man, because I don't know where they're going to be mentally at.
quotes.quote: This is going to be tough, man, because I don't know where they're going to be mentally at. That's hard to recover from. I would like to see them win this game. I want them to push it to six. I want to see more basketball. I think they're definitely capable. Again, I had Knicks winning Game 4 anyway, just not like that. Like I was okay with San Antonio lost. I was not okay with how they lost in that fashion. And that's harder for them to bounce back from. I thought Knicks would win Game 4, Spurs would win Game 5, and go to six, and then maybe Knicks will probably bring it home then, but it's hard to bounce back from that type of loss.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Spurs' recovery
quotes.excerpt: I just don't see how only two days in concussion protocol you can recover and play a basketball game.
quotes.quote: I just don't see how only two days in concussion protocol you can recover and play a basketball game. Usually it takes a week. I see the Knicks winning this game handily easy.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre on OG Anunoby's impact
quotes.excerpt: OG Anunoby, plus or minus 19 points. That's at a minus 105, man.
quotes.quote: OG Anunoby, plus or minus 19 points. That's at a minus 105, man. What do you think? Does he get more than 19?

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on OG Anunoby's performance
quotes.excerpt: Over. He's going to get over 19.
quotes.quote: Over. He's going to get over 19. I don't see how you stop a moving train.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jalen Brunson's performance
quotes.excerpt: I'm going over on Jalen. I just like I said, the recovery for San Antonio.
quotes.quote: I'm going over on Jalen. I just like I said, the recovery for San Antonio. And then as a great player, and he's shown to be a great player, uh, he's been phenomenal over the last few years for the Knicks. As the series goes along, you start figuring out some things. And it looks like he's figured out San Antonio. And I have him going over.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre on De'Aaron Fox's future with the team
quotes.excerpt: Do you foresee a future where Fox remains on the team and Harper still comes off the bench?
quotes.quote: Do you foresee a future where Fox remains on the team and Harper still comes off the bench? My fear is that if he's not starting by next season we may end up loosing Harper by the time that rookie contract is up.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on De'Aaron Fox's development
quotes.excerpt: Al Horford comes off the books, Harrison Barnes comes off the books, Jeremy Sochan comes off the books.
quotes.quote: Al Horford comes off the books, Harrison Barnes comes off the books, Jeremy Sochan comes off the books. It's like $40 million. I don't know if you want to bring one of those guys back, but you have $40 million. Those three young guys aren't getting paid yet. Champagnie's on a cheap deal at a player team option for $3 million. Um, yeah, Kelden Johnson's under for one more year, Vassell, the only one that's really getting paid like that. So you have space and time. It's very premature. Off of one series, off of one game, off of one postseason thing, these still these young guys are going to take our, you know, and learn. So, hopefully they come out like that. We'll see if they can bounce back. It's not easy, but they have to have like, uh, amnesia, short-term amnesia, and just try to move on from it and and win the next one, one game at a time.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on Jimmy Butler's potential impact
quotes.excerpt: The one player that comes to mind just off the top is like a Jimmy Butler.
quotes.quote: The one player that comes to mind just off the top is like a Jimmy Butler. Like to have him in that locker room, they don't lose this game. Have him on that side. You know what I'm saying? Like, because he brings leadership, experience, he's been to the finals, he's all star, he's a veteran. He gives he gives the qualities of that. So I would look somebody with those type of qualities if you're going to trade a De'Aaron Fox.
